# Upstream reuse matrix

This matrix records the currently exercised Kani/Verus automation boundary. Discovery metadata never grants proof credit; checked Verus receipts remain the proof-bearing path.

| Capability | Pinned upstream file/symbol | Coupling | Existing Destiny equivalent | Decision | Required adaptation | Validation | Remaining limitation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cargo discovery | Kani `kani-driver/src/project.rs::cargo_metadata_only` (local patch over `KaniSession::cargo_build`) | Cargo metadata + Kani compiler toolchain; stops before GOTO linking | Existing vendor bootstrap and controller | **Thin adapter implemented** | Metadata-only autoharness/list path in the pinned Kani patch | CI builds patched Kani and runs discovery while CBMC/GOTO executables are hard-blocked | Still coupled to the pinned Kani rustc-private toolchain |
| Entry-point/autoharness classification | Kani `kani-compiler/src/kani_middle/codegen_units.rs`, `kani_metadata::AutoHarnessMetadata` | rustc-private compiler selection; serialized output is backend-neutral enough to consume | Existing specification inventory | **Direct compiler-output reuse implemented** | Normalize chosen/skipped functions into selected/excluded/unsupported/blocked records | Rust adapter tests + real compiler discovery in CI | Kani eligibility does not imply Verus semantic support |
| Arbitrary input construction | Kani automatic-harness compiler passes and `Arbitrary` eligibility | MIR/type system/Kani semantics | Restricted Verus quantified-input generator | **Eligibility reused; values re-expressed only for declared scalar subset** | Independent Verus parameters with recorded domains; selected generic instance retained | Valid fixture, independent-input regression, selected-generic regression | Pointers, allocation, target-width integers, floats and general ADTs remain unsupported |
| Autoharness metadata/result classification | Kani `kani_metadata::{KaniMetadata,AutoHarnessMetadata,AutoHarnessSkipReason}` | Pure serialized metadata | None | **Directly reused** | Normalize without copying Kani schema | `verification/automation` unit tests + compiler-produced fixture metadata | Metadata is selection/provenance, not proof evidence |
| Function-contract discovery | Kani `library/kani_macros/src/sysroot/contracts/bootstrap.rs::ContractConditionsHandler::contract_clause_marker`, `kani_metadata::{ContractedFunction,ContractClause}`, compiler `gen_contracts_metadata` | Clauses are parsed by Kani's own proc-macro layer, transported through generated local helpers using Kani's existing `fn_marker`, and exported by the pinned metadata extension | Destiny specification/contracts and reviewed Verus entries | **Compiler-parsed clause export implemented** | Preserve crate/function/file/harness identities plus parsed clause kind/expression; validate/deduplicate in binder | Rust adapter tests, Python binder tests, real Kani contract fixtures | Metadata itself never carries proof credit |
| Contracts/stubs semantics | Kani parsed contract clauses + Verus `requires`/`ensures` | Kani macro parsing is reused; proof semantics are re-established by Verus for the declared subset | Restricted generated Verus obligations | **First semantic bridge implemented** | Lower non-arithmetic scalar `requires`, unit-result `|_|` `ensures`, and scalar-return result-reference `ensures`; separately prove precondition satisfiability | Valid contract, false-postcondition, contradictory-precondition, and arithmetic-rejection fixtures | `modifies`, `old`/history, references/calls, contract arithmetic, non-scalar/richer result structures, recursion remain unsupported |
| Compiler instrumentation | Kani compiler MIR passes | rustc-private and backend lowering | None | Reuse only backend-independent outputs before GOTO-specific lowering | Keep versioned process/data boundary | Patched metadata-only build is pinned and integrity-checked | General Kani MIR transformations are not portable Verus proofs |
| Symbolic assumptions/path handling | Kani autoharness selection plus source `kani::assume` syntax; Verus verifier | Source semantics + restricted structural lowering | `verification/tools/verus_subset.py` | **Implemented for declared scalar grammar** | Preserve program-point assumptions and separately prove non-vacuity for feasible non-arithmetic prefixes | Valid/contradictory-assumption fixtures | Arithmetic-dependent non-vacuity paths are rejected rather than ghost-widened |
| Machine arithmetic | Rust/Kani checked machine arithmetic; Verus fixed-width executable expressions | Semantics diverge from mathematical ghost integers | Restricted generated Verus obligations | **Implemented only for guarded executable `+,-,*`** | Keep operations executable so Verus must prove no overflow/underflow | Guarded pass + overflow/underflow failure fixtures | Ghost arithmetic, casts, division/remainder and target-width integers remain unsupported |
| Loop handling | Kani bounded exploration concepts; Verus proof kernel | Different completeness models | Literal-loop generated slice | **Exact literal-range exhaustion implemented** | Unroll `for _ in A..B` up to 32 iterations and record bound | Valid literal-loop fixture + evidence assertion | Not a general loop invariant or termination proof |
| Execution scheduling | Kani `kani-driver/src/harness_runner.rs` | VerificationResult/CBMC runner/rayon | Aegis controller budgets/supervision | Keep Destiny controller; do not duplicate | Reuse selection metadata, not CBMC scheduler | Existing controller/campaign gates | Kani runner is explicit reference backend only |
| Verus Cargo/proof planning | Verus verifier + Destiny reviewed concurrency plan | Verus toolchain and proof source | `verification/plans/verus-concurrency.json`, `run_verus_campaign.py` | **Existing campaign retained** | Bind Kani-selected supported functions to exact reviewed Verus obligations | Fresh campaign receipts checked by `bind_kani_verus.py check-campaign` | Reviewed correspondence is a trust boundary, not a general translation theorem |
| Result/evidence handling | Kani metadata + Verus output + Destiny Aegis evidence | Different proof semantics | Existing receipts/bindings/audit | **Existing evidence extended, not replaced** | Keep engine/outcome/provenance independent; record parsed contract clauses, generated Verus contracts, and non-vacuity obligations | Strict Verus parser, stale-input checks, exact receipt inventory | No proof credit is inferred merely from Kani contract metadata |
| Counterexample playback | Kani concrete playback | CBMC model/trace specific | Explicit reference lane | **Implemented as separate Kani/CBMC source replay** | Manual temporary harness imports unchanged original failing fixture | Replay unit tests + CI reference replay when Verus gate permits | Autoharness playback is not supported by pinned Kani; replay grants no Verus proof credit |
| Test infrastructure | Kani compiler fixtures; Verus checked fixtures | Tool-specific expectations | Existing Rust/Python regressions | **Shared corpus with backend-specific expectations implemented** | Keep valid/invalid/unsupported/contract-discovery cases explicit | Automation Rust tests, Python translator/binder tests, real compiler discovery fixtures | Broader Rust language coverage remains intentionally unsupported |
| CI packaging | Pinned Kani/Verus sources and releases | Toolchain-specific | `.github/workflows/formal-verification.yml` | **Integrated vendor-boundary gate** | Build Kani from source, forbid backend executables during discovery, carry artifacts into Verus job | CI automation-boundary job; exact upstream integrity checks | Whole workflow can still fail on independent Destiny/Kani proof regressions outside this automation boundary |
